detail.longDescription: What if a chemistry concept taught for nearly 100 years has been explained incorrectly? Researchers say the inductive effect in neutral molecules may not gradually extend across three or four chemical bonds as many textbooks teach. Instead, their findings suggest its influence may stop after just one bond. 😮 Modern tools are giving scientists new ways to challenge ideas that have been accepted for generations. Read more: https://www. sciencedaily.com/releases/2026 /09/260913082157.htm # Chemistry # Science # OrganicChemistry # Education # Research
